meta.what: Finger gaps over the 22 best layouts of the re-score of 2026-11-16 (rank100_summary.json's lists), owner's question (18:2x, via the lab): "is there a similarly performing layout, from our old sweeps, that dont have such close proximity / real-world collision?". Per layout: every ground-clear grasp (grid2dgr) at seed 0 and the film grid's best grasp (grid2dff) at seeds 0-2, each from its own 8 mm open pose, in the calibrated simulation at the 7.5 V plant (gain and torque limit x1.5, assumed), budget 0.56, pads with soft contact, contacts to HOM off, the hand's MCP stops. gap = least surface distance between the index's and the middle's spheres (hom_setup.finger_pts: tip pad r 11, tip end r 6, PIP r 8 mm) over the run, for the joint states and for HOM's targets. On the hand the fingers came about 10 mm closer than in this simulation (g13: 1.9-7.8 mm against 13-17; g0 at (70, 110): 17.1 against 27). Four runs ended in HOM's SVD failure (sphere dropped).
